{{Recipe}}

This '''sweet potato soup''' is inspired by flavors of Southeast Africa and Asia, with the addition of ginger and lime. 

== Ingredients ==

* 6 [[Cookbook:Potato|sweet potatoes]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] fresh [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] chicken and vegetable [[Cookbook:Broth and Stock|stock]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook: Water|water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] cream
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]], juiced

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook: Knife|Knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stovetop]]
* [[Cookbook:Saucepan|Saucepan]]

== Procedure ==

# Place the peeled potatoes, ginger, stock, and water in a large saucepan.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until the potatoes are softened and tender (approximately 30 minutes).
# Transfer the contents of the pot to a blender along with the lime juice, and process until smooth. You may need to work in batches. Alternatively, you can use an immersion blender.
# Return the soup to the pot, stir in the milk, and allow to cook for few minutes until heated through.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can adjust the consistency of the soup as desired by adding more or less water, milk, and stock. Less liquid will produce a thicker soup.
